from datetime import datetime

# Parse the travel date to get the departure date
departure_date_str = "May 20, 2025"

# Calculate the return date (4 nights later)
from datetime import timedelta
return_date = datetime.strptime(departure_date_str, "%B %d, %Y") + timedelta(days=4)
return_date_str = return_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

# Search for outbound flights from Fresno to Portland
outbound_flights = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Fresno",
    end_airport_city="Portland",
    departure_date=[departure_date],
    flight_class=["business"]
)

# Save outbound flights to cache
save_to_cache(key="outbound_flights", value=outbound_flights)

# Search for return flights from Portland to Fresno
return_flights = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Portland",
    end_airport_city="Fresno",
    departure_date=[return_date_str],
    flight_class=["business"]
)

# Save return flights to cache
save_to_cache(key="return_flights", value=return_flights)

# Search for hotels in Portland for 4 nights

)
